lines.text: If the son accepts the words, calls out to insight, and seeks wisdom like silver, he will find understanding.
The son will discover the knowledge of God, because the LORD gives wisdom and is a shield to those with integrity.
Wisdom will enter the son's heart, and discretion and understanding will watch over him and guard him.
Understanding will deliver the son from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of light.
Understanding will rescue the son from the forbidden woman, who forgets the covenant of her father and whose house sinks down to death.
